set.body: Design EventSchedule allows signed Seconds, but StimulusEvent converts onsets to NonNegativeSeconds. This rejects a valid first-run pre-acquisition event while a later-run global offset can admit the same local schedule. BIDS task-events explicitly allows negative onsets; duration remains nonnegative. Fix the native domain boundary, retain finite checks and source identities, verify causal HRF/FIR carry-over with independent interval-overlap expectations and run-translation tests. Do not silently clip/shift source events. JVM/JS hrf plus design consumers required. Consumer temporal-support gate plsneuro bd-01M1VKM2RSV5DZ56FEN7CK2WCA. Source https://bids-specification.readthedocs.io/en/v1.10.0/modality-specific-files/task-events.html
set.title: Permit finite signed event onsets through the regressor boundary
